name: post-training-atlas
description: Track post-training method evolution, compare iterations, and turn research signals into evidence-grounded ideas.

interface.shortDescription: Track method evolution and research ideas.
interface.longDescription: A research skill for following post-training method families across language, reasoning, agents, multimodal, generative, and embodied models; comparing what changed; and turning evidence into testable ideas or coding plans.
defaultPrompt: Track the evolution of a post-training method and cite primary papers.
Use the atlas to find transferable ideas for my research problem.
Turn this post-training research brief into a careful coding plan.
